passages.text: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was the son of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was a priest.
Jeremiah belonged to the priests in Anathoth.
Anathoth was in the territory of Benjamin.
These are the words of Jeremiah.
passages.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ מִן־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃

passages.text: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah, and through the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, until the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
He was the son of Hilkiah.
He was one of the priests in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin.
The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
This happened in the thirteenth year of King Josiah’s reign.
Josiah was the son of Amon.
Josiah was king of Judah.
The word of the LORD also came to Jeremiah during the days of Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
The word of the LORD continued until the eleventh year of Zedekiah’s reign.
Zedekiah was the son of Josiah.
Zedekiah was king of Judah.
In the fifth month of that year, the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃ וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ תֹּם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה עַד־ גְּל֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס

passages.text: The word of the LORD came to me, saying: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said these words to me.
He said, “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.
Before you were born, I set you apart.
I appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בְּטֶ֨רֶם אֶצּוֹרְךָ בַבֶּ֙טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔יךָ וּבְטֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵרֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑יךָ נָבִ֥יא לַגּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a young man.
Jeremiah spoke to the Lord God.
Jeremiah said, “Ah, Lord God.”
Jeremiah said, “I do not know how to speak.”
Jeremiah said, “I am only a child.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי־ נַ֖עַר אָנֹֽכִי׃פ

passages.text: But the LORD told me: “Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.'"
You must go to everyone I send you to.
You must speak everything I command you to say.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י אַל־ תֹּאמַ֖ר נַ֣עַר אָנֹ֑כִי כִּ֠י עַֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid of them.
I am with you.
I will deliver you.
This is what the LORD declares.”
passages.original: אַל־ תִּירָ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְהַצִּלֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD reached out His hand.
The LORD touched Jeremiah’s mouth.
The LORD said to Jeremiah, “I have put My words in your mouth.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ וַיַּגַּ֖ע עַל־ פִּ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖י בְּפִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God gave Jeremiah a special task.
God appointed Jeremiah on that day.
God set Jeremiah over nations and kingdoms.
God gave Jeremiah authority to uproot.
God gave Jeremiah authority to tear down.
God gave Jeremiah authority to destroy.
God gave Jeremiah authority to overthrow.
God gave Jeremiah authority to build.
God gave Jeremiah authority to plant.
passages.original: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣יךָ׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ וְעַל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת לִנְת֥וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֖וֹץ וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וְלַהֲר֑וֹס לִבְנ֖וֹת וְלִנְטֽוֹעַ׃פ

passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” “I see a branch of an almond tree,” I replied.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He asked me a question.
He said, "Jeremiah, what do you see?"
I answered Him.
I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר מָה־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וָאֹמַ֕ר מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה׃

passages.text: “You have observed correctly,” said the LORD, “for I am watching over My word to accomplish it.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, “You have seen well.”
The LORD said, “I am watching over My word.”
The LORD said, “I will make sure My word happens.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ לִרְא֑וֹת כִּֽי־ שֹׁקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עַל־ דְּבָרִ֖י לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “What do you see?” “I see a boiling pot,” I replied, “and it is tilting toward us from the north.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me a second time.
He asked me a question.
He said, “What do you see?”
I answered him.
I said, “I see a boiling pot.”
The pot is facing toward the north.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֵלַי֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר סִ֤יר נָפ֙וּחַ֙ אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה וּפָנָ֖יו מִפְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָה׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land.
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to me.\r\nThe LORD said, “Disaster will come from the north.\r\nThis disaster will fall on everyone who lives in the land.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י מִצָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח הָרָעָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north,” declares the LORD. “Their kings will come and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem. They will attack all her surrounding walls and all the other cities of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, “I am about to act.
I will call all the families and kingdoms from the north.
This is what I, the LORD, declare.
The kings from the north will come.
Each king will set his throne at the entrance of Jerusalem’s gates.
They will come against all the walls around Jerusalem.
They will come against all the cities of Judah.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְכָֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּבָ֡אוּ וְֽנָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜וֹ פֶּ֣תַח׀ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְעַ֤ל כָּל־ חוֹמֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness, because they have forsaken Me to burn incense to other gods and to worship the works of their own hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD will announce His judgments against the people.
The people have done many evil things.
They have abandoned the LORD.
They have burned incense to other gods.
They have worshiped idols they made with their own hands.
passages.original: וְדִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַי֙ אוֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל כָּל־ רָעָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be intimidated by them, or I will terrify you before them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God gave Jeremiah a command.
God told Jeremiah to prepare himself.
God told Jeremiah to stand up.
God told Jeremiah to speak to the people.
God told Jeremiah to say everything that God commanded him.
God warned Jeremiah not to be afraid of the people.
God said He would make Jeremiah afraid in front of them if Jeremiah feared them.
passages.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֔יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֙ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־ תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־ אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Now behold, this day I have made you like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God gave Jeremiah a special role.
God made Jeremiah strong and secure.
God made Jeremiah like a fortified city.
God made Jeremiah like an iron pillar.
God made Jeremiah like bronze walls.
God set Jeremiah against the whole land.
God set Jeremiah against the kings of Judah.
God set Jeremiah against the officials of Judah.
God set Jeremiah against the priests of Judah.
God set Jeremiah against all the people of the land.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נְתַתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם לְעִ֨יר מִבְצָ֜ר וּלְעַמּ֥וּד בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּלְחֹמ֥וֹת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂרֶ֔יהָ לְכֹהֲנֶ֖יהָ וּלְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, “They will fight against you.
They will not defeat you.
I am with you.
I will rescue you.
I, the LORD, declare this.”
passages.original: וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־ י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃פ
